review_description: Aussie Made Solar generally deal with Tindo (Aussie Made panels) I chose the LG 275w panels and got 3.725kw for the same price as the Tinda 3kw.  Both with Enphase micro inverters.Your help started the ball rolling for me,  I did get a quote from all companies.
Too soon to rate higher - will raise rating to excellent if all is still working as planned in 10 years time.
Aussie Made were a pleasure to deal with.  Everything that they offered they delivered on time and no fuss.

I would not hesitate to recommend Aussie Made Solar to anyone wanting a similar high quality system. Their knowledge and professionalism was evident from the outset (other installers we sought bids from only wanted a sale). The installation was painless, on-time, clean and neat. I am a consulting civil engineer and I recognise quality service when I see it - as in this case.

Failure of the inverter ( older model). Unit was swapped out within 10 days. Response from the Aussie Solar Made staff excellent. Since had CB at the mains board trip three times  but the system has been working OK after resetting.
From day 1 this system has been fantastic with the saving of money per quarter, ease of installation and great customer service.  I would be happy to recommend this system to any future buyers.

It is a very good system, lot dearer than other systems, but we made that choice. After two years in operation, the inverter system developed a problem and shut down. On 1st April 2014, I rang Latronic Sunpower pty ltd at Caloundra, Queensland. They emailed me how to disconnect the inverter and I took it to them in Caloundra, which is about 80ks away.The inverter was repaired and I had it back home and reinstalled within 3 hours. I was quite happy with the service.

We loved knowing that we were installing an Australian made system using Australian materials and labour.  The system was specifically built for our extreme weather conditions and any replacement parts are readily available in Australia.  The service they provided was absolutely brilliant and the system is giving us an excellent return for our money.  We wouldn't hesitate to recommend them to anyone thinking of installing a solar panel system.
We initially installed a 2kw system but then within the year upgrade to a 3kw system. I also had the same system installed in an Investment house I own.
We were very happy with the way Gino went about the quote and installation. Very, very trustworthy indeed.
We spoke to Gino at the Brisbane home show and he was fantastic with every part of the process.

When getting quotes from two other popular brand companies, it was obvious they were more interested in sales at any price than providing details on which we could make our decision. Aussie Made Solar was the only company who came to the house to take measurements and explained the system in a professional manner. The system has worked efficiently since it was installed in mid-2012, and has saved us a great deal of money on power bills. Being close to the sea, it was important to have heavier duty aluminium frames for the panels and we are glad we did. Solar is too important to just buy on cheap price. I would not hesitate to recommend our chosen installer.
Honest salesman!!! Thanks Gino.

12 months after installation we struck a problem.  From the person who took our inital call through to the person who resolved it, the attitude was brilliant.  Our problem was their top priority. Problem resolved - all under warranty and as quickly as possible by them.Would thoroughly recommend Aussie Made Solar.

Our experience with Aussie Made Solar was great, We also recommended them to our friends around the street, who got theirs installed from Aussie too.It has been more than two years since we had our installation and there have been no complaints. Best thing about this company is that they keep in touch, I would have not expected it from any other company. I am writing this review after 2 years of installation, so obviously I am one happy customer and I am pretty sure our friends are too.I would highly recommend them to anyone who wants a Solar System and values Aussie quality work.
Very happy with Gino and Aussie Made Solar, we were keen to buy Australian made products and they have proven top quality and produce power as per original quote.

Value for money: The micro inverter technology is a little bit more expensive however you get the benefits of new technology.  I can check daily on my iphone (via an app) how much power my solar panels are generating (both in historical or real time). Micro converter technology is also very flexible to expand as it only requires purchasing of additional panels as each panel has it's own inverter.Quality of system:  A+++  High quality.Installation: A+++ Very professional.  No messy wires, very tidy.  The guys were punctual, installed panels, hooked system up, explained internet monitoring of panels, cleaned up and were gone before 2.30pm.Customer Service:  A+++ Gino was very polite, frank and honest in the advice her provided. It was a pleasure to conduct business with him and Aussie Made Solar.I highly, highly, highly recommend AUSSIE MADE SOLAR for all you solar panel installation needs!!!!!!

It is very important to us to support Australian made and owned products.  We have had no problems with the system since installation and we haven't paid for an electricity bill since either.  The products are more expensive than others, but you definitely get what you pay for.  Would definitely recommend Aussie Made Solar.  It is a long term investment.

We conducted extensive research in advance of installing our photo-voltaic system and concluded that Australian-made was in our long-term best interests. In searching for an Australian made system, we couldn't go past Aussie Made Solar, which offered on-shore manufacturing using the very best leading-edge Australian and European-made components.  We are in no doubt that we have gotten the value and reliability we paid for.  The system, which Aussie Made Solar installed in 2012, is working exactly as predicted.  We are delighted.  The customer service at Aussie Made Solar has been exemplary, from sales through to installation and post-commissioning monitoring. We are pleased to commend Aussie Made Solar to anyone looking for a first-class Australian made product supported by expert, reliable and very personable customer service.
I bought a 2.5kW addition to my existing 1.5kW system. The installer went to considerable effort to resolve an issue with the supply authority on my behalf.
Have recommended Aussie Made Solar to friends and they have had systems installed by Aussie Made Solar as well, we're all happy lil' Aussie Made Solamites.

So very happy with the total outcome of installing this micro inverter remote monitored system. Invest and pay that little bit more for the latest quality Australian world class technology, coupled with proven management systems. 'Support yourself', while supporting a worthwhile local business.
We would thoroughly recommend the company in all aspects and are extremely pleased with the solar output for us.

The service I received from Aussie Made Solar was exceptional, I had no idea what type of solar system I wanted and with in 48 hours they had made arrangements to come out to my home and quote on 2 different systems, I had always had it in my mind that I only wanted an Australian made system and they were so helpful. The cost of the system was more that I expected to pay but I am more than happy with the results, I would encourage anybody considering solar panels to research the micro inverter system with Aussie Made Solar.
I had two previous systems installed with this company and all installed as promised. Contacts with Gino and his team were always professional and on time.

I purchased my Australian made Solar system, plus the inverters also made in Australian because Of quality and most important the warranty who can you get in touch with overseas to assist  if there is a problem, I will always support home grown products. Aussie made solar show professionalism and very courteous in the installation. And support after.
I can ring Gino anytime for any queries that I may have which is very pleasing to me.
Good to deal with, nice guy.

I chose an Aussie system because it is more robust and designed for our climate and harsh weather. I like that each panel has it own mini invertor making each independent from others and unlike an inline one invertor system still produces electricity and delivers it to the home even if panels are down. Production can be monitored via my internet and will immediately indicate if panels are down.This activity is also accessed by the installer who can correct or address any failings immediately. I've had no issues with the system unlike imports where after receiving quarterly accounts, found no production during that time. With no Govt. buy back and only low offerings from power suppliers, Power generated through the day powers the house and I only sell the excess to the retailer.This way we use all heavy users of power, like dishwasher, washing machine during that time. Aussie Solar a local company, was very helpful and completed the installation in a timely, professional manner.

Experience was  excellent  *from the first phone call for a quote* thorough answers to all questions* the installation dates and times* follow up services.* always availableI was very pleased with Aussie Made Solar.

The guys at Aussie Made Solar gave me a no-bull assessment on my circumstances,  only quoting me for the system I needed and not the one that would earn them the most money.Knowing that they used Australian Made products played a large part in my decision to go with them, and I haven't had any reason to regret my choice.With their online monitoring system, they routinely monitor the performance of their panels and micro inverters, and will call me without prompting to rectify the situation.As my experience with the feed-in system had been so good, I did not hesitate to contact them when I was ready to take the next step and install an off-grid system with battery backup.Both times the installation was efficient and hassle free, with Benson and Gino turning up when they said they would, and finishing within their planned timeframe.I have already, and will continue to recommend Aussie Made Solar to anyone who is looking at making the commitment to clean energy.
